## Where to look hardest

- use-end-game.ts: the retry effect reads `wanted.current` during drawing (`retryStands`); a pad change that does not redraw could leave one extra retry.
- tracker-controller.ts `watchOffline`: the timer runs on the controller's clock against the queue's `unansweredSince`.
- No browser check for items 1 to 5; scoring-trouble-test (54) passed after them; scoring-plays-test was left running, result not read.

## Fix round A

- H1 (use): a device showing a final game asks again with a plain read (`loadState`) every 15 s while shown (`finalCheckMs`), at once on awake or online; live again it opens the game as at the start (who is scoring), final with another score it shows that score. T-295 pending file has it as Agreed. Tests: tracker-controller-end (two T-295 cases), browser check in scoring-trouble-test (56 checks passed; the reopen was learnt in 9 to 10 s).
- M1 (code): a play entered again takes an ID worked out from the kept play's (`again-command-id.ts`), so a second tap or a reload never records it twice; a list removal that fails answers `not-taken-off` and the screen says so (`tracker.keptList.againNotTakenOff`).
- M2 (code): the hold is written once less than 95 s are left (`holdSpareMs` 90 s plus one check), not half the lease; about one write per 30 s. The reviewer's hold-margin test is in renew-scoring-session.test.ts; one database test adjusted.
- M3 (code): the 5-minute warning counts the longer of the wall and steady clocks, judged again on awake (`judgeOffline`). Test: tracker-controller-sleep.test.ts.
- Not done (for the second session): code M4, L1 to L5; use M1 to M3 and the Lows. A device still in scoring mode for the few seconds after it ended a game does not notice a reopen made in those seconds.
